Unzip it and run **Ebb.exe**. Keep `Ebb.Helper.exe` next to it.

| Download | Size | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| `Ebb-…-win-x64.zip` | about 70 MB | nothing |
| `Ebb-…-win-x64-needs-dotnet8.zip` | about 3 MB | the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0) |

Ebb isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say **Windows protected your PC** the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
